digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler identity write and rollback
propositions: Failed identity writes in dispatch_one.create_one delete successfully-created Jira issues via delete_issue call in the exception handler, destroying recoverable work

A keyed-pending binding persists after issue deletion because record_pending_key runs before identity writes, stranding the local ticket permanently as recover_pending repeatedly fails on the dead key
The retro-attach path in recover_pending.keyed branch already deterministically recovers failed identity writes without search, making the rollback delete redundant and destructive

The Jira 'Field cannot be set' error has three distinct causes (missing from screen, jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property, malformed value) but is misleading about which applies, requiring operator-facing error clarity
rebar requires labels field on project Create and Edit screens but does not validate this requirement upfront, leaving deployments with custom screens vulnerable to permanent identity write failures
